title: Binance Options Will Launch T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options on  2024-02-21  at  08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options are European-style options contracts. Binance Options will launch T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options on  2024-02-21  at  08:00 (UTC) . Thereafter, T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options will be listed every day at  08:00 (UTC) . Please note that there will be no new T+4 BTCUSDT Daily Options listing if it coincides with the expiration of a BTCUSDT Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly options contract that day. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-02-20
